name: construction-marketplace-drizzle
description: - `docs/ERD.md`: ERD, relationships and integrity rules. - `docs/MIGRATION-REVIEW.md`: change log and validation status. - `db/schema/index.ts`: Drizzle schema including payout accounts and idempotency fields. - `db/migrations/0000_initial.sql`: initial PostgreSQL schema. - `db/migrations/0001_hardening.sql`: additive hardening migration. - `db/migrations/meta/_journal.json`: migration journal. - `tests/smoke.sql`: PostgreSQL smoke test for ledger balancing and immutability. - `scripts/verify-migration.sh`: applies migrations and smoke test on a disposable DB.
